grade.message: Our Delta flight from Barbados (DLR03A) was delayed and diverted for a crew change and we only got to JFK at 3:35 am with my 4 year old. The Lyft I had booked for midnight cancelled on us and still charged me a $5 fee, and I had to pay about $200 for an Uber home. I want that Lyft fee back. Is any refund or compensation offered for this? If anything is owed for the Lyft cancellation, please claim it for me and tell me the result. Does Delta owe us any compensation for the delay? The Uber fare itself was correct. Can I get the Uber paid? I am not asking for goodwill or an escalation, only the Lyft fee and straight answers on Delta and the Uber. talia.brooks@example.com, card 4303.
